entity: 13F reports still filed in thousands instead of dollars after the Jan 2023 rule change
what_we_add: the 355-of-8,631 count, the ~$2.6T understatement, and T. Rowe Price as a third of it
why: Finrep states filers with legacy systems are still rounding to thousands and producing non-compliant filings: the same finding in words, same direction. The T. Rowe and Barclays primary documents are blocked on non-paywalled pages, so only the vendor blog carries it, with no counts.
